Du bist nicht nur strategische:r Produktdenker:in, sondern auch operative:r Umsetzer:in. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen marktfähige Lösungen werden — klar priorisiert, sauber spezifiziert und mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden.

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie, Produktvision und Roadmap für PAQATO und stellst sicher, dass Produktentscheidungen auf Unternehmensziele einzahlen
  • Du priorisierst das Delivery Backlog und triffst fundierte Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Kundenwünschen, technischem Aufwand, wirtschaftlicher Machbarkeit und strategischem Nutzen
  • Du führst eigenständig Kundengespräche, Discovery-Interviews und Anforderungsanalysen durch und leitest daraus konkrete Produktanforderungen ab

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Rückfragen aus der Entwicklung und bewertest gemeinsam mit Tech Lead und UX die technische und fachliche Machbarkeit
  • Du begleitest Features von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis hin zu Testing, QA, Abnahme und Release

  • Du analysierst Markt, Wettbewerb und Kundenfeedback und entwickelst daraus Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts

  • Du nutzt moderne Tools, KI-Anwendungen und Automatisierungen, um Produktarbeit effizienter, strukturierter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten

This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. Google Ads is a core part of our growth strategy. We operate across multiple countries and brands, creating both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, finding performance opportunities, and continuously improving results through testing, analysis, and execution. Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance You will not be joining a business that is trying to figure out whether Google Ads works. While most work is done remotely, we believe that spending time together in person remains valuable, particularly as the company continues to scale. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years. This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Candidates whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes inside an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and be comfortable taking ownership of results, not simply providing recommendations.

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

We bring together manufacturing expertise, advanced software and AI to help teams improve production at scale. The goal is to make production more efficient, more resilient and more sustainable, and to help teams make better decisions where they matter most.

We are a highly motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and passion for what we do. Our entrepreneurial mindset and commitment to innovation have enabled us to grow fast and help shape the future of manufacturing with cutting-edge software. At ONIQ, culture is just as important as product. We foster an environment rooted in authenticity, diversity, integrity, and mutual respect, where everyone is encouraged to bring their whole self to work.


What you will do

You will support the Sales and Growth teams across the entire sales cycle by generating data-driven insights, qualifying leads, maintaining CRM data quality, and contributing to go-to-market and sales execution activities. You will work closely together with other teams such as customer onboarding, customer success, and marketing. You will:

  • Analyze market trends, customer segments, and internal sales performance to generate actionable insights for Customer Portfolio and Sales Management
  • Support the qualification of leads through structured research and data-driven assessment
  • Maintain quality of customer and opportunity data within the CRM system, ensuring transparency across the sales pipeline
  • Contribute to our international go-to-market and market entry initiatives by supporting market analyses, competitive benchmarking, and rollout activities
  • Support the sales execution process by preparing commercial documents such as quotations, order confirmations, and standard contractual materials
  • Coordinate the preparation, documentation, and follow-up of customer meetings, sales reviews, and internal alignment workshops
  • Be part of the entire sales cycle from marketing to customer onboarding and actively support marketing and sales activities such as campaigns, events, and digital initiatives


What we expect from you

  • You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Ideally, you have gained initial practical experience through internships or student roles, preferably in customer service, marketing or customer-facing functions
  • You are available for a six-month internship or a working student position. Shorter internships may be possible depending on your availability and experience.
  • You are highly organized, able to work independently, and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and reliability
  • Advanced communication skills and strong interpersonal skills
  • Enthusiasm for the possibilities of digitalization and willingness to familiarize yourself with a SaaS B2B product for manufacturing processes
  • A hands-on mentality and readiness to take ownership within a fast-paced, dynamic team
  • Excellent language skills in both German and English (C1 level or higher)
  • We love the energy that comes from working together in person, so spending time at our Cologne office matters to us. One on-site day per week is the minimum, and more time together is always welcome whenever it works for you


What we offer

  • A culture built on transparency, integrity and authenticity – we trust and respect each other and make decisions based on competence
  • A team that genuinely cares about collaboration and work culture: we regularly reflect on our teamwork, invest work time into team spirit and consciously create balance in everyday work
  • The opportunity to contribute to fighting climate change by helping industrial manufacturers to become more efficient and to reduce their CO₂ emissions, while we are mindful of our own environmental impact as a carbon-neutral company
  • All the benefits that make work more pleasant: flexible hours, remote work possibilities, regular team events and offsites, 30 days PTO, weekly yoga sessions and more

Interesse am Gesundheitsbereich: Du begeisterst dich für den Gesundheitsmarkt, digitale Innovationen und HealthTech und möchtest die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten. Praktische Erfahrungen: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Business Development, Venture Development, HealthTech oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt. Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir dir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester. Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO : Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir. Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen. Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse. Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da. Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. raw.description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

    • Within 12 months, you will:

  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

description: Wir wollen vorankommen, Du auch? Bei unseren Kunden steht gerade viel an: Virtualisierungsplattformen werden modernisiert, Windows-Server-Umgebungen weiterentwickelt und Active-Directory-Strukturen abgesichert. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Infrastruktur versteht, technische Entscheidungen trifft und Projekte sauber umsetzt. In unserem Infrastrukturteam übernimmst Du Verantwortung – von der Konzeption über die Migration bis zum sicheren und zuverlässigen Betrieb. Verfügbarkeit und Wiederherstellbarkeit sicherstellen: Du entwickelst Backup- und Wiederherstellungskonzepte weiter und sorgst für funktionierendes Monitoring, Patch-Management und regelmäßige Wiederherstellungstests. Komplexe Störungen lösen: Du unterstützt als technische Eskalationsinstanz im 3rd-Level-Support, analysierst Ursachen und setzt nachhaltige Lösungen um. Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Hypervisoren und Virtualisierung, beispielsweise Proxmox, Hyper-V oder VMware – einschließlich der zugehörigen Storage- und Netzwerkanbindung. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien, DNS und DHCP sowie Erfahrung mit Datei- und Berechtigungsstrukturen und Remote Desktop Services. Praktische Erfahrung mit Windows Server Security und AD Hardening, etwa mit Sicherheitsrichtlinien, der Trennung administrativer Berechtigungen und dem Schutz privilegierter Konten. Einen sicheren Umgang mit Backup, Wiederherstellung, Monitoring und Patch-Management. Gute PowerShell-Kenntnisse für Administration, Analyse und Automatisierung. Eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Du dokumentierst verständlich, erkennst technische Abhängigkeiten und sprichst Risiken frühzeitig an. Die Fähigkeit, Kunden technische Zusammenhänge und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu erklären. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Benefits Abwechslungsreiche Infrastruktur- und Migrationsprojekte mit technischem Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Möglichkeit, unsere Standards für Virtualisierung, Windows Server und IT-Sicherheit aktiv mitzuentwickeln. Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und fachlichen Austausch im Team. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, die Dich fachlich und beruflich weiterbringen. Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Raum für Deine Ideen. Klingt nach Dir? Dann schick uns Deine Bewerbung an! Für den Anfang reicht uns ein Lebenslauf. Bei Fragen vorab kannst Du Dich gerne an unseren Personalleiter Andreas Renner wenden. Du bist ungekündigt beschäftigt? Das erste Telefonat führen wir gerne auch nach Feierabend. Über uns Die tilko GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Planung, Modernisierung und dem zuverlässigen Betrieb ihrer IT – von Server- und Virtualisierungsumgebungen über Cloud-Dienste bis zu Netzwerk- und WLAN-Lösungen. Dabei zählen für uns Qualität, Verlässlichkeit und Teamgeist. Wir schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Wertschätzung im täglichen Miteinander spürbar sind und Du Verantwortung übernehmen und mitgestalten kannst. Job Title: Junior Campaign Manager, DACH

Work Location: Berlin, DE (Remote but must be located in Berlin and open to coming into the office)

Start Date: As soon as possible

 

Whalar, part of Accenture Song is the leading, most awarded Creator and Social agency. We transform brands into cultural drivers by unlocking the full creative power of Creators.

We go beyond the conventional social and influencer strategy. We have the technology and methodology to tap into the beating pulse of communities, listen to nuances that move culture, and connect brands in ways that make them unforgettable.

With hubs in London, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, our reach is global.

 

About the role:

The ideal candidate is creative, personable, loves social media and creators, is highly organized, and deadline-driven, they should be culturally savvy to help take our work to the next level. Reporting to our Associate Director at Whalar, the Client Services Executive is a community-facing role and will serve as the main liaison between creators and the business, leading on talent scouting and casting, briefing, content gatekeeping and reporting across collaborations within the vertical. This person will facilitate the seamless delivery and implementation of brand strategies to the highest standard.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

  • Creator Sourcing: Source, gather information and demographics, and vet creators across multiple platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and more. 
  • Creator Management: build strong relationships with creators throughout a campaign cycle and beyond, from outreach, negotiations, onboarding and contracting to creator briefing, creative concept review, content gatekeeping, content scheduling and campaign feedback loops. This may also include managing product logistics for a campaign.
  • Creative Briefing: Develop and issue creator briefs, immersing creators into the campaign, and lead day-to-day communications for content development.
  • Content Review & Quality Control: Be the first point for review of all creator content. Check for ASA and IP compliance, alignment with brief and quality of content, and create an efficient feedback loop back to creators.
  • Content Scheduling & Monitoring: Create a posting schedule and keep it up to date throughout the campaign period. Monitor posts once they are live to ensure accuracy and to flag any negative sentiment the post may be receiving.
  • Campaign Performance: Work closely with the Manager on overall campaign success, including updating campaign trackers consistently, timeline management, budget management, data capture and wrap reports.
  • Act as a cultural pulse of all things creator economy - live and breathe social media, consuming and presenting back trends and new discoveries.

Here's what we're looking for:

  • Have 1+ years' experience in project management and/or creator and influencer landscape
  • Have strong communication, organization and interpersonal skills
  • Be proactive, productive and positive
  • Have a love for social media and content creators
  • Culturally in tune, finger on the pulse - new platforms, trends, industry news
  • Have a creative & curious mindset, pioneering spirit and a can-do attitude
  • Appreciate and understand the value of great creativity
  • Thrive in an environment where collaboration, flexibility and scrappiness are valued more than job titles, rigid structure and legacy ways of working
  • Be a team player, willing to roll their sleeves up and dive in
  • Enjoy a fast paced working environment 
  • Excellent customer service
  • Have an analytical mind and be comfortable with numbers
  • Must be a native-level German speaker with fluent professional level English speaking and writing capabilities. 

 

We are an office-based company located in Kurfürstendamm, Berlin, with a flexible approach to in-office days. Employees are asked to work from the office minimum 1+ days a week, with Tuesday being our main day in the office. We come together as a team to collaborate, connect, and celebrate the vibrant and unique Whalar culture!

Our values:

At Whalar, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement, it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers. 

The perks:

Whalar provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments/experiences, so employees can work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs.

  • 25 days of PTO + winter break
  • Monthly phone/internet reimbursement
  • Professional development stipend
  • New joiner home office allowance 
  • Volunteer days
  • Social programs
  • Urban Sports

Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS) to support the Department of the Air Force Family Advocacy Program in Spangdahlem, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. The FAIS serves as a clinical provider and prevention specialist responsible for supporting intervention and secondary prevention efforts related to domestic abuse, child maltreatment, problematic sexual behavior in children and youth, and family wellness.

The FAIS may augment the services of the Family Advocacy Treatment Manager and is expected to perform the applicable clinical and prevention responsibilities associated with the FATM role.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide clinical intervention, counseling, assessment, and case management services to individuals, couples, families, and groups.
  • Support assessment and treatment of domestic abuse and child maltreatment cases.
  • Conduct psychosocial, safety, risk, needs, and other clinical assessments as appropriate.
  • Develop and monitor individualized treatment and safety plans.
  • Provide psychotherapy, psychoeducation, crisis intervention, advocacy, and clinical casework.
  • Provide secondary prevention services addressing domestic abuse, child maltreatment, and problematic sexual behavior in children and youth.
  • Deliver New Leader Orientation and annual training to commanders, first sergeants, organizational leadership, and key agencies.
  • Serve as a prevention facilitator and installation FAP representative for the Community Action Team and other community organizations.
  • Develop, promote, and implement FAP prevention programs under the direction and approval of the FAP Manager.
  • Develop social marketing and outreach strategies to increase awareness of family maltreatment prevention resources.
  • Identify family violence trends and collaborate with FAP personnel and community organizations to target prevention efforts.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of prevention activities and support required program reporting.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Clearance:
    • Must be eligible for and maintain required privileging within the Military Treatment Facility
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination in accordance with applicable contract and government requirements
  • Education, Licensure, and Certifications:
    • Must be a U.S.-licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
      • LCSW: Master's degree from a CSWE-accredited school
      • LMFT: Master's degree from a COAMFTE-accredited Marriage and Family Therapy program, or an appropriately qualifying allied mental health degree with equivalent Marriage and Family Therapy study
    • Must maintain the applicable unrestricted professional license
    • Must meet all applicable clinical privileging requirements
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification
  • Required Experience:
    • LCSW: Two years of post-MSW experience within the last three years in a clinical/treatment setting
    • LMFT: Two years of experience within the last two years as a marriage and family counselor
    • Two years of full-time post-master's clinical counseling experience serving individuals who are abusive or abused
    • Demonstrated group therapy facilitation or co-leadership experience
    • Experience working with children, families, groups, professionals, and community agencies
  • Physical Requirements:
    • Ability to travel within the assigned area for outreach, prevention, and community activities
    • Ability to work in clinical, office, community, and other approved environments
  • Work Environment:
    • Work is performed in clinical, office, community, and outreach settings and may involve interaction with individuals and families experiencing sensitive or challenging circumstances
Position Pay Range
$80,000—$120,000 USD

About Copper River & The Native Village of Eyak:

Owned by the Native Village of Eyak (NVE), a federally recognized Alaska Native Tribe, the Copper River Family of Companies are a collection of entities that deliver a complementary set of solutions and services to support the diverse missions and requirements of our clients. Proud participants of the Small Business Administration's (SBA) 8(a) Business Development Program since 2006, our companies consist of both current and graduation SBA 8(a) entities. It is our collective purpose to support the Tribe and diversify the NVE's ability to facilitate economic advancement.

The income generated from our companies helps the Native Village of Eyak fund health and social services, economic development, natural resource/environmental education, jobs, job training, and other benefits to the NVE in a manner that is consistent with Alaskan Native cultural values and traditions.

Copper River's Culture

The Copper River Family of Companies has a positive, supportive, and thriving culture. At the foundation of our culture is a focus on collaboration. No matter your role or which operating company you work for, we are ONE TEAM working toward the same goals for our customers and for our collective owner- The Native Village of Eyak. How we treat each other is just as important as the work we deliver.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
  • Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
  • Retirement 401(k) with employer match
  • Open leave policy and paid holidays
  • Additional benefits including tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more! 

Note: Benefits are offered based on employment classification and applicable contract requirements. Eligibility may vary by position.

Über die Rolle 

Führung und Personal 

  • Du führst fachlich und einsatzsteuernd ein Team von 6 Ausbildern (Theorie, Praxis, Sprache, §14d TfV) und verantwortest Mitarbeitergespräche, Beurteilungen sowie Onboarding.

Fachliche Überwachung & Hospitation 

  • Du führst regelmäßige Hospitationen in Theorie und Praxis durch, wertest diese aus und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Du stimmst dich regelmäßig mit der Leitung Prüfungsorganisation ab und stellst die Einhaltung der Anforderungen gemäß §7 TfV Abs. 3 sicher.

  • Du stellst die Einhaltung und Dokumentation gemäß IMS, DIN ISO 29993 und 21001 sicher und unterstützt bei internen und externen Audits, z.B. durch EBA und Zertifizierungsstellen.

If you're energized by winning new business, meeting decision-makers, and building partnerships that drive real growth, this is your opportunity.

What You'll Do

Win the Best Retail Partners

Own Your Territory

Build Strategic Relationships

Create Commercial Impact

Build Something Bigger

Real Ownership

title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
company: Mittwald CM Service GmbH & Co. KG
description: Wir verstehen uns längst nicht mehr als klassischen Webhosting-Anbieter. Deswegen planen wir die Gründung von zwei neuen Plattform-Teams. Gestartet wird gemeinsam am 04.01.2027. Mit anderen neuen DevOps´lern startest du in ein intensives Onboarding-Programm, das dich gezielt auf die Arbeit in unserer Infrastruktur vorbereitet. Wir schulen dich in unserem Tech-Stack (Go, Linux, Kubernetes & Helm) und zeigen dir die Themen, die unsere tägliche Arbeit an der Plattform prägen. Du sollst verstehen, wie unsere Systemumgebung aufgebaut ist und wie du selbst daran weiterarbeiten kannst. Nach dem gemeinsamen Einstieg geht es für dich in dein Team. Jetzt heißt es: Wissen einsetzen, weiterlernen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung übernehmen. Für diese Aufgaben machen wir dich fit: Du gestaltest die Systemumgebung unserer Webhosting-Produkte und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft Du entwickelst unsere Kubernetes-basierte Hosting-Plattform weiter - stabil, performant und skalierbar Du arbeitest an spannenden Use Cases, zum Beispiel der Entwicklung von Kubernetes Operatoren und Bare Metal Deployments Du überwachst die Kubernetes-Cluster mit Hilfe von Monitoring-Tools wie Prometheus, Grafana und Opsgenie zur Störungsprävention Durch kreative Ansätze, entwickelst du neue Automatisierungen und verbesserst die Qualität unserer Plattform durch deine Ideen Du bist neugierig und aufgeschlossen für Neues, verfolgst die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Open-Source-Welt und probierst neue Technologien aus Gut zu wissen: Darauf kannst du dich freuen: Tiefgang statt Standard Ja, wir sind ein Hosting-Unternehmen. Aber wer einmal gesehen hat, was unter der Haube steckt, hört auf uns so zu nennen. Deine Chance an Technik zu arbeiten, die die meisten nur aus Talks kennen. Wir lieben Tech Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein. Technik trifft Menschlichkeit Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei. Rundum-sorglos-Setup Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt. So läuft´s ab: Deine Bewerbung Du reichst deine Bewerbung ganz einfach über den Link in der Stellenausschreibung ein. Statt eines perfekt polierten Lebenslaufs interessieren uns hier vor allem deine Antworten auf ein paar Fragen. so ausführlich oder knapp, wie du magst. Eine kleine Challenge Wenn es passt, schicken wir dir eine kleine Aufgabe, die du in Ruhe zuhause bearbeitest. Dabei geht es nicht um tiefes Wissen, sondern darum, wie du denkst und an Probleme herangehst. Ein Tag bei uns Wenn´s passt, geht es in die nächste Runde. Dann lernen wir uns vor Ort kennen, und zwar gemeinsam mit anderen, die wie du im Januar neu bei uns anfangen könnten. Es erwartet dich ein lockerer Vormittag mit Rundgang und Kennenlernen, ein gemeinsames Mittagessen und eine kleine fachliche Challenge. Dabei bekommst du einen echten Eindruck von uns, dem Onboarding-Programm und den Menschen, mit denen du vielleicht schon bald zusammenarbeitest. Dein Vertragsangebot Alles hat gepasst? Dann besprechen wir dein Vertragsangebot und stoßen auf deine Zusage an. Und am 4. Januar starten wir gemeinsam. Das bist du: Du tüftelst gerne und findest strukturierte Wege, um Probleme zu lösen. Wenn die bekannten Mittel nicht helfen, denkst du weiter Du willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert. Du denkst dich systematisch in Sachverhalte hinein und erkennst Abhängigkeiten, die andere übersehen Du hängst dich so lange in etwas hinein, bis du es wirklich verstanden hast. im Tunnel fühlst du dich wohl Du hast schon mal einen Server aufgesetzt, egal ob für Games, Home-Projekte oder einfach, weil du wissen wolltest, wie´s geht Nach deinen bisherigen Experimenten mit Linux, Containern und Cloud-Tools weißt du: Du willst systemnah arbeiten Kontaktperson: Robert Lipkowski Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Berlin ASAP
description: ennovationHUB is a fast-growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC. As we scale toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of the Google Ads performance of one of our brands within our portfolio, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability. This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will be working inside a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and direct visibility into how your work impacts revenue and profitability. Google Ads is a core part of our growth strategy. We operate across multiple countries and brands, creating both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, finding performance opportunities, and continuously improving results through testing, analysis, and execution. You will work closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns are not only performing well today but continue to scale efficiently as the business grows. Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance You will not be joining a business that is trying to figure out whether Google Ads works. It already does. Your role is to help us take performance to the next level by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where small improvements can have a significant impact. You will be working with experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who can think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support role and it is not a reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and have a direct impact on the growth of the business. This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Candidates whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered. We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes inside an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and be comfortable taking ownership of results, not simply providing recommendations. Our Ideal Candidate Will Have: 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Highly analytical with strong attention to detail Fluent in English, both written and spoken Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement Able to take ownership and make decisions independently We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change Senior, but practical Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements Focused on outcomes rather than activity Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns Available to start immediately / ASAP We are investing in building a stronger presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team is spread across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. The role requires travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work is done remotely, we believe that spending time together in person remains valuable, particularly as the company continues to scale. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years. In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value: Accountability over excuses Execution over talk Clarity over politics Learning through doing We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. raw.title: Working Student – Investor Relations & Fundraising (all genders)
raw.description:
Working Student – Investor Relations & Fundraising (all genders)

Vireo is looking for a Working Student to join our Investor Relations and Fundraising work in Berlin.

You will work closely with our Head of Investor Relations and support the team across fundraising, LP research, investor communication and selected business development activities.

The role is designed for someone towards the end of their Bachelor’s degree or currently pursuing a Master’s who wants to learn how a venture capital fund works beyond the investment process. You will see how we prepare fundraising, work with existing and prospective LPs, communicate our work and build Vireo’s network across the European investment and EnergyTech ecosystem.

A large part of the job is research and preparation. We are looking for someone who is extremely precise, quick to understand new topics and comfortable working independently once the task is clear.

What you will do

Fundraising & LP Research

You will support our ongoing fundraising activities and help us research prospective investors, including family offices, institutional investors and corporates.

This includes:

  • researching potential LPs, their investment activities, strategies and relevant contacts

  • preparing short investor profiles and meeting briefings

  • keeping our LP and fundraising research structured and current

  • supporting the preparation of investor meetings and follow-ups

  • researching specific investor segments, markets and networks when we want to understand them in more depth

We don’t expect you to arrive knowing the European LP landscape. You should want to learn it.

Investor Relations

You will support the day-to-day work with our existing and prospective investors.

You will help prepare meetings and materials, maintain information in our CRM and make sure notes, next steps and relevant documents are properly recorded.

You will also support regular investor communication and help prepare presentations, updates and other materials for our LPs.

This part of the role requires attention to detail. We work with a large number of conversations and information at the same time, and we need someone who enjoys keeping that work organised.

Communications & Positioning

Investor Relations at Vireo also involves communicating what we see in the market.

You will work with us on topics coming from our portfolio, the EnergyTech market and the wider VC ecosystem and help assess which of them are relevant for our investors and network.

Your work can include researching a topic, preparing a first draft, collecting data or portfolio examples, supporting an investor update, developing material for an event or helping prepare a media opportunity.

This is not a social media or marketing role. The communications work is closely connected to our fundraising, investor relations and business development activities.

Business Development & Events

You will help us research people, organisations and events that are relevant to Vireo.

Before conferences and LP events, you might analyse attendee lists, research investors and prepare briefings for the team. Afterwards, you will help us structure the information and follow-ups coming out of those meetings.

There will also be opportunities to join selected events and get to know the VC, LP and EnergyTech ecosystem in person.

AI & Research

AI should be a normal part of how you work.

We use it for research, preparation, analysis and recurring workflows. We are looking for someone who already uses these tools confidently and is interested in testing new ones.

You should also know when AI isn’t good enough. Investor names, fund information, numbers and meeting details need to be correct.

Who we are looking for

You are currently studying business, economics, finance, management or a related subject. You are ideally towards the end of your Bachelor’s degree or already pursuing a Master’s.

You don’t need previous VC experience.

You should:

  • work with a high degree of accuracy

  • be a strong and persistent researcher

  • be interested in Venture Capital, fundraising and the LP side of the industry

  • write clearly in English and ideally also in German

  • be able to turn research into concise, useful information

  • be comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, presentations and structured data

  • use AI tools confidently in your everyday work

  • be comfortable working on several tasks at the same time

  • take responsibility for the quality of your own work

  • be based in Berlin and able to work regularly with us in person

Experience in a startup, VC, finance, consulting, communications or another fast-moving environment is useful, but not required.

What you will learn

The role gives you practical exposure to VC fundraising over a period of 6–12 months.

You will learn how LP research works, how fundraising pipelines are managed, how investor meetings are prepared and how a fund communicates with different types of investors.

You will also get to know the European VC and EnergyTech ecosystem and see how fundraising, investor relations, communications and business development interact in the day-to-day work of a venture fund.

You will work closely with our Head of Investor Relations and have regular interaction with other members of the Vireo team.

Application

Please send us your CV. You don’t need to write a cover letter.

Instead, please answer these two questions briefly:

  1. Imagine you’re asked to identify 20 potential LPs that could be relevant for a European EnergyTech VC fund. How would you structure your research?

  2. Pick one recent development in EnergyTech or Venture Capital that you think Vireo should be part of the conversation around. Why – and with whom?

description: Hallo! Schön, dass du hier bist. Wir sind Klickkonzept, Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe. Aber um ehrlich zu sein: Wir suchen keine klassischen „Werkbank-Arbeiter", die den ganzen Tag nur Gebote nachjustieren und ACOS-Werte hin- und herschieben. Die Zeiten sind vorbei. Wir suchen T-Shaped Marketer. Wir suchen strategische Architekten von morgen. Wir suchen dich – als unseren neuen Umsatz-Designer. Warum „Umsatz-Designer" und nicht einfach Amazon Manager? Weil sich die Welt des Retail Media fundamental gedreht hat. Algorithmen und automatisierte Kampagnentypen nehmen uns die kleinteilige Handarbeit ab. Das ist keine Gefahr, sondern die größte Chance unserer Branche! Es gibt uns endlich die Zeit, das große Ganze zu betrachten. Als T-Shaped Marketer bei uns baust du eine tiefe Expertise im Amazon-Advertising-Bereich auf (der vertikale Strich im „T"). Aber du blickst auch nach links und rechts (der horizontale Strich). Du verstehst, dass die beste Kampagne nutzlos ist, wenn Listing, Content und Preisstrategie nicht stimmen, und dass Amazon Ads nur ein Hebel im gesamten Retail-Ökosystem sind. Du lernst bei uns, keine isolierten Kampagnen, sondern ganzheitliche, umsatzgenerierende Ökosysteme für unsere Kunden zu gestalten. Aufgaben Deine Spielwiese (Das machst du bei uns): Kampagnen-Management & Skalierung: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Amazon-Advertising-Kampagnen (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, perspektivisch auch DSP) für spannende nationale und internationale Marken. Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für eigene Accounts – mit einem erfahrenen Team im Rücken, das dich fördert. Retail & Advertising im Zusammenspiel: Du weißt, dass Advertising-Performance auf Amazon untrennbar mit dem Rest verbunden ist – Listing-Qualität, A+ Content, Buy Box, Bewertungen und Preis. Du erkennst diese Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für deine Kunden ab. Datenanalyse & Reporting: Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick (ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, Conversion Rate, Share of Voice), erkennst Muster in den Daten und übersetzt sie in klare Handlungsempfehlungen. Tools wie die Amazon Ads Console, Amazon Marketing Cloud oder Drittanbieter-Software sind dabei deine Werkzeuge. Cross-Channel-Denken: Du arbeitest nicht in Silos. Du verstehst, wie Amazon Advertising mit Paid Social, SEA und Content zusammenspielt, und wächst Schritt für Schritt in die Rolle des strategischen Beraters hinein. KI-Enablement: In unserem eigenen „AI Lab" identifizieren wir neue Use Cases. Du nutzt aktiv generative KI, um deine Workflows zu optimieren, Keyword- und Kampagnenstrukturen zu iterieren und schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen. Qualifikation Was du in deinem Werkzeugkoffer mitbringst: Du hast ca. 1–3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Management von Amazon-Advertising-Kampagnen (Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands sind dein Zuhause; Sponsored Display, DSP oder Amazon Marketing Cloud sind ein Plus). Du kennst dich im Amazon-Ökosystem aus und verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Advertising, Seller/Vendor Central, Listings und organischem Ranking. Du denkst in Kennzahlen: ACOS, TACOS, ROAS und Conversion Rate sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Analytisches Denken und Datenliebe stecken in deiner DNA. Du bringst ein Grundverständnis für angrenzende Marketingdisziplinen mit (z. B. Paid Social, SEA, Content, Web Analytics) – operativ musst du sie nicht beherrschen, aber du willst verstehen, wie alles zusammenspielt. Du bist kommunikationsstark, präsentierst gerne und hast Freude daran, Daten in verständliche Geschichten zu übersetzen – auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du hast keine Angst vor Fehlern, denn du testest gerne hypothesenbasiert und lernst aus jedem Outcome. Vor allem aber: Du hast Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln und über dich hinauszuwachsen. Benefits Was wir dir bieten (Deine Opportunity): Echte Flexibilität: Deine Work-Life-Integration ist uns heilig. Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. Personal Growth: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Wir investieren in deine Weiterbildung durch interne Trainings und externe Coaches – gerade in den ersten Jahren begleiten wir dich eng, damit du deine T-Shape kontinuierlich ausbauen kannst. Kultur & Wohlfühlfaktor: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, Teamevents und eine Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Und ja, Bürohunde sind bei uns nicht nur erlaubt, sondern absolut erwünscht! Fokus-Squads & Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten in agilen, 6–7-köpfigen Fokus-Squads direkt an unseren Kunden. Das bedeutet für dich: kurze Wege, ein intensives Teamgefühl und gemeinsamer Erfolg, den ihr als Einheit feiert. Globale Perspektive: Durch die Zugehörigkeit zur Labelium Group arbeitest du an internationalen Projekten und hast Zugang zum Wissen von über 1.200 hochkarätigen Spezialisten weltweit. Sicherheit: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sachbezüge, Essenszulagen, Mitarbeiterrabatte und gute Verkehrsanbindungen an unseren Standort in Frankfurt. Klingt das nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt? Genau dafür bauen wir seit 2011 eine Plattform, mit der heute über 1,1 Millionen Dienstleister:innen, Selbstständige und Unternehmen authentische Kundenstimmen sichtbar machen – und damit erfolgreicher werden. Unsere Tools helfen dabei, Bewertungen gezielt zu nutzen – für bessere Sichtbarkeit in SEO und Social Media sowie einen starken Online-Ruf. Unser Headquarter sitzt in Berlin, ein weiteres Office in Madrid. Unser Team ist genauso international wie unsere Kund:innen. Wir arbeiten über Grenzen hinweg zusammen, digital wie vor Ort, immer mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Vertrauen online greifbar und nutzbar zu machen.Worauf du dich freuen kannst: Bei uns zählt jede Idee. Wir sind ein Team, das Eigeninitiative Aufgaben Du entwickelst unsere technische CRM- und Marketing-Automation-Architektur weiter und setzt komplexe Workflows, Trigger und Lifecycle-Automationen in Brevo und HubSpot um. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Marketing, Sales und Customer Success in technische Prozesse und automatisierst wiederkehrende manuelle Abläufe. Du entwickelst und betreust Integrationen zwischen CRM, Produkt, Website, Data Warehouse und weiteren Systemen. Dabei arbeitest du mit REST APIs, Webhooks und den erforderlichen Authentifizierungsverfahren. Du stellst sicher, dass Kontakte, Accounts, Aktivitäten und Einwilligungen vollständig und konsistent zwischen den Systemen verarbeitet werden. Du betreust gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam die technische Infrastruktur für Marketing- und transaktionale E-Mails. Dazu gehören Versanddomains, Subdomains, IPs und DNS-Einträge sowie die korrekte Einrichtung von SPF, DKIM und DMARC. Du überwachst die Zustellbarkeit und Sender-Reputation, unter anderem mit Google Postmaster Tools. Du analysierst Bounces, Spam-Beschwerden, Blocklists, Feedback Loops und Inbox Placement und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Du entwickelst Prozesse für Domain- und IP-Warm-ups, Suppression Lists sowie den Umgang mit Hard Bounces, Soft Bounces und inaktiven Kontakten. Risiken durch Spam Traps, Phishing, Spoofing und fehlerhafte Verteilerstrukturen erkennst du frühzeitig. Du entwickelst responsive E-Mail-Templates mit HTML und CSS und testest ihre Darstellung sowie dynamische Inhalte auf unterschiedlichen Geräten, in E-Mail-Clients und bei verschiedenen Postfachanbietern. Du implementierst und prüfst Tracking-Parameter, Events und Conversion-Zuordnungen und sorgst für die korrekte Übertragung an Analyse- und Reporting-Systeme. Du richtest Monitoring und automatische Benachrichtigungen für kritische Workflows, Schnittstellen und den E-Mail-Versand ein. Bei Fehlern analysierst du die technischen Ursachen und behebst sie eigenständig. Du entwickelst technische Testfälle, prüfst Änderungen vor Releases und dokumentierst Ergebnisse, Datenflüsse, Abhängigkeiten und technische Entscheidungen. Du berücksichtigst Datenschutz und Consent Management bei der Umsetzung und stellst die korrekte Verarbeitung von Opt-ins und Opt-outs sicher. Du arbeitest im RevOps-Team eng mit Entwicklung, Produkt, Marketing, Sales und Customer Success zusammen und bereitest technische Entscheidungen verständlich auf. Qualifikation Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung oder Administration von CRM- und Marketing-Automation-Systemen mit, beispielsweise als CRM Manager, CRM Developer oder Marketing Automation Manager. Du verfügst über sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse in Brevo und HubSpot CRM und hast bereits komplexe Workflows, Trigger und automatisierte Customer Journeys umgesetzt. Du arbeitest sicher mit REST APIs, Webhooks und strukturierten Datenformaten wie JSON. Du verstehst, wie Daten zwischen Systemen synchronisiert werden und wie du ihre Qualität sicherstellst. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit HTML und CSS, insbesondere bei der Entwicklung responsiver E-Mail-Templates. Du kennst dich mit DNS, Versanddomains und E-Mail-Authentifizierung aus und hast bereits mit SPF, DKIM, DMARC und Google Postmaster Tools gearbeitet. Du bringst Erfahrung in Fehleranalyse, Testing und technischer Dokumentation mit. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, analysierst Zusammenhänge und setzt technische Lösungen eigenverantwortlich um. Komplexe Datenflüsse erklärst du so, dass Fachbereiche und Entwicklung damit arbeiten können. Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams und die technische Dokumentation. Zusätzliche Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche ist von Vorteil: Du hast mit Integrations- und Automation-Tools wie Make, Zapier oder n8n gearbeitet. Du hast KI-gestützte Anwendungen oder Automationen mit Large Language Models entwickelt. Du kennst Monitoring, Logging und automatisiertes Alerting sowie Consent-Management-Plattformen und Preference Center. Du hast Erfahrung mit transaktionalen E-Mails, der technischen Trennung unterschiedlicher Versandarten sowie IP- und Domain-Warm-ups, Feedback Loops und Blocklist Monitoring. Du nutzt E-Mail-Testing-Tools wie Litmus oder Email on Acid. Benefits Du erhältst ein Bruttojahresgehalt zwischen 40.000 EUR und 60.000 EUR bei 40 Wochenstunden, abhängig von deiner Qualifikation und einschlägigen Erfahrung. Ein internationales, offenes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und freie Wahl der Hardware Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen sowie aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Werde Teil unserer Reise Bei ProvenExpert glauben wir an die Stärke der Vielfalt. Unser Team besteht aus talentierten Individuen unterschiedlicher Hintergründe, Kulturen und Perspektiven. title: Team Lead Service Inside Sales (m/w/d)
description: Sie sind eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit im technischen Innendienst mit Führungserfahrung und möchten den nächsten Schritt gehen? Dann übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Servicegeschäfts. Als Team Lead Service Inside Sales (m/w/d) führen Sie unser Service Inside Sales Team fachlich, entwickeln Vertriebsstrategien weiter und gestalten gemeinsam mit Ihren Mitarbeitenden nachhaltiges Wachstum. Werden Sie Teil von Calibrationhouse (eine Marke der GMC-I Service GmbH) und tragen Sie aktiv dazu bei, unsere Position als führender Servicedienstleister für elektrische Mess- und Prüftechnik weiter auszubauen. Das Calibrationhouse (Marke der GMC-I Service GmbH) in Nürnberg ist weltweiter Servicedienstleister für hochwertige elektrische Mess- und Prüftechnik. Wir sind Teil der internationalen GMC INSTRUMENTS Gruppe, welche erstklassige Mess- und Prüfgeräte entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt - und zwar schon seit über 120 Jahren. Zu den bekanntesten Marken zählt GOSSEN METRAWATT, für welche wir exklusiver Reparaturdienstleister sind. Mit unseren 90 Mitarbeitenden am Standort Nürnberg Langwasser reparieren und kalibrieren wir, führen Firmware- und Software-Updates durch und bieten einen Mietgeräte- und Ersatzteilservice an. Aufgaben In Präsenzarbeit führen, motivieren und entwickeln Sie unser Team und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für nachhaltigen Vertriebserfolg. Sie verantworten den Ausbau des Serviceumsatzes in Ihrem definierten Markt- und Kundenbereich und entwickeln aktiv neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Sie steuern die Service-Vertriebspipeline von der Lead-Generierung über die Kundenansprache bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Sie bauen bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter aus und identifizieren neue Potenziale für langfristige Partnerschaften. Sie beraten Kunden zu unseren Serviceleistungen und entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen mit technischem und wirtschaftlichem Mehrwert. Sie arbeiten eng mit den Produktvertriebsteams zusammen, um Serviceleistungen gezielt mit Produkten zu verbinden und zusätzliche Cross-Selling-Potenziale zu erschließen. Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit Service Operations, Produktmanagement und Marketing, um eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Serviceangebote sicherzustellen. Sie begleiten Vertriebsaktivitäten durch strukturiertes CRM-Management, Forecasting und regelmäßiges Pipeline-Reporting. Sie vertreten unser Unternehmen auf Messen, Veranstaltungen und Branchennetzwerken und stärken unsere Marktpräsenz. Fachlich dem Service Sales Lead unterstellt, treiben Sie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Vertriebsprozessen voran und bringen Ihre Erfahrungen aktiv in die Optimierung unserer Serviceorganisation ein. Qualifikation Fachlich Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung und oder ein abgeschlossenes, einschlägiges Studium. Mehrjährige nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Servicevertrieb ist Voraussetzung, idealerweise im Bereich der elektrischen Mess- und Prüftechnik oder vergleichbaren technischen Branchen. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden oder Vertriebsteams sowie Leitung von Projekten ist zwingend erforderlich. Erfolgreiche Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen sowie nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Erreichung von Vertriebs- und Umsatzzielen. Technisches Verständnis und die Bereitschaft, sich kontinuierlich in unsere Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Marktanforderungen einzuarbeiten. Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen sowie Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit Vertriebskennzahlen, Forecasts und Pipeline-Management. Grundlegendes Verständnis relevanter Industriestandards ist vorteilhaft. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Persönlich Eine ausgeprägte Vertriebs- und Abschlussorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, neue Geschäftspotenziale zu erkennen und erfolgreich umzusetzen. Ein sicheres Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und die Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen verständlich und überzeugend zu vermitteln. Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und ein professionelles Auftreten auf allen Ebenen. Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenmotivation. Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams, sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen erfolgreich zusammenzuführen oder unabhängig zu arbeiten. Benefits Das erwartet Sie bei uns Eine anspruchsvolle Führungsaufgabe mit direktem Einfluss auf Wachstum und Vertriebserfolg. Die Möglichkeit, ein engagiertes Service Inside Sales Team weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen. Ein modernes, technisches Arbeitsumfeld mit innovativen Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie kontinuierliche fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Eine attraktive Vergütung und zusätzliche Benefits. Ein kollegiales Umfeld mit hoher Kunden- und Serviceorientierung. Die Chance, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und einen sichtbaren Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens zu leisten. title: People Advisor
description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline People Team 👋 At Trainline, our People team plays a vital role in enabling our business and colleagues to thrive through growth, innovation and transformation. As we continue to evolve our People operating model, we're creating more opportunities for our People Partners to focus on strategic partnership, helping leaders build high-performing, future-ready teams. This role sits at the heart of that journey, supporting our mid-level managers as they navigate day-to-day people priorities. As the People Advisor, you'll work closely with and support our People Partners, partnering directly with mid-level managers to coach and guide them through key people processes that enable business performance. You'll play an important role in helping evolve how the wider People Partnering team operates over the coming months, working closely with managers and colleagues across the People function to build a more proactive, insight-led approach to partnering, while supporting the business through change and embedding new ways of working. In this role as the People Advisor, you will...🚄 Support our People Partners across organisational design, restructures and business transformation initiatives, including collective consultation, and provide support on employee relations (ER) work where required. Work closely with our ER specialist and Learning & Development (L&D) team to shape requirements, build workflows for key ER processes and develop manager development pathways that provide upskilling where needed. Support the development of a high-performance culture by coaching managers through performance management, calibration, capability development and challenging conversations with confidence and fairness. Drive continuous improvement across the People function by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve workflows and embrace AI and automation to create greater efficiency and enable more strategic partnering. Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition, Reward, Learning, People Operations and Legal to deliver integrated people solutions that support both immediate priorities and longer-term organisational goals. Contribute to the evolution of the wider People Partnering team by sharing best practice, supporting new ways of working and helping build a more strategic, commercially focused partnering model across the function. We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 Experience in People Operations or a similar People Advisory role, where you've worked across elements of the employee lifecycle. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to coach, challenge and influence managers while adapting your style to different audiences. Experience in a generalist People partnering background, including employee relations and employment law, would be ideal. Experience improving People processes and ways of working, with curiosity about how AI and emerging technologies can enhance the employee experience and the effectiveness of the People function. A collaborative approach, with experience working across Centres of Excellence and People teams to deliver joined-up, business-focused solutions. A growth mindset and enthusiasm for helping shape the future of People Partnering, supporting colleagues through change and contributing to the ongoing development of the wider People team. More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy. Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated. Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn , Instagram and Glassdoor ! title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good. From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector. Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time. About the role As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards. This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise, engineering leadership, and confident client-facing skills. What you'll be doing: Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML systems Designing and building production-grade ML software, tools, and scalable infrastructure Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth Who we're looking for: You understand the full ML lifecycle and have significant experience operationalising models built with frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes) System Design Interview (90 minutes) Commercial Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.   • Experience in a production, traffic, or studio management role coordinating a multi-person creative or production team

title: EMEA Solutions Engineer / Sr. Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>LogicGate® is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.</p> <p><strong>Excited about LogicGate but not familiar with GRC?&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>GRC stands for Governance, Risk, and Compliance</li> <li>GRC professionals help their companies manage uncertainty, act with integrity, and stay on the right side of the law.&nbsp;</li> <li>The GRC market is rapidly expanding with continuous growth opportunities. The current market size was valued at $50.5 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031.</li> </ul> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>At LogicGate, we recognize that exceptional talent comes in all shapes and forms, and that there is no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. The qualifications below represent the core competencies, skills, and experiences that align most closely with the day-to-day responsibilities of this role - if you don't check every single box and are excited about this work, we still highly encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Solutions Engineer is LogicGate's pre-sales technical expert. You'll run discovery sessions to understand what a prospect's risk program needs to accomplish, configure and deliver tailored Risk Cloud demonstrations, build proof-of-concept applications, and ensure every prospective customer has a clear and credible picture of how our platform addresses their specific GRC challenges. This role requires both product mastery and a genuine curiosity about how modern organizations manage risk and compliance.</p> <p>You'll report to our Solutions Engineering Manager, joining a small, close-knit SE team where your work directly shapes how prospects experience the platform.</p> <p>Our Solutions Engineering team sets a high bar because our work matters. SEs are instrumental in every customer decision, serving as trusted technical advisors throughout the buying journey. We hire people who are collaborative, intellectually curious, and eager to raise the level of the team, and in return, they join an environment where they'll be challenged, supported, and surrounded by teammates who make them better.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Present: </strong>Conduct highly effective product demonstrations with prospective customers and LogicGate Account Executives as part of the sales process.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate: </strong>Lead client workshops for data and process gathering to uncover details of current state processes, related business challenges, and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li><strong>Discover:</strong> Listen to understand customer pain points and connect their needs to LogicGate solution features.</li> <li><strong>Build:</strong> Configure LogicGate's no-code platform for customized demonstrations and proof of concept projects with prospective customers.</li> <li><strong>Consult:</strong> Build relationships with prospective customers and become a trusted advisor throughout the sales process.</li> <li><strong>Educate: </strong>Conduct webinars and assist in content creation (white papers, blog posts, etc.).</li> <li><strong>Product Insight:</strong> Provide feedback and intelligence to the Product team to identify new potential features and functions and represent the voice of prospective customers.</li> <li><strong>Customer Success Support:</strong> Collaborate with Customer Success and Implementation Management teams in the transition of customers to ensure a seamless experience post-sale.</li> <li><strong>Own: </strong>Take full ownership of the technical cycle across your territory — from first discovery call through to a clean handoff post-close.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tools We Use to Help You Make the Most of Your Time</strong></h2> <ul> <li>AI-Powered RFP Automation</li> <li>AI Agents to support demo and POC configuration</li> <li>Gong for call recording, note-taking, and onboarding</li> <li>Access to AI to streamline your day to day activities</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <h3><strong><em>Required:</em></strong></h3> <ul> <li>3–5+ years of experience within GRC, Cyber Risk, or adjacent fields as a Solutions Engineer, Consultant, or Practitioner</li> <li>Experience tailoring and conducting software demonstrations or client / customer-facing presentations</li> <li>Curiosity and the desire to understand our customers' problems – and then effectively communicate how LogicGate can add value to their organization</li> <li>Ability to manage a number of projects and engagements simultaneously</li> <li>A desire to work within a team focused on winning new business and expanding customer accounts</li> <li>Hybrid Work Readiness &amp; Travel Flexibility: Demonstrated capability to communicate and collaborate seamlessly across distributed teams, with the flexibility to travel as needed for key team offsites, company events, and customer meetings.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><em>Nice to Have:</em></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience selling, implementing, or administering GRC SaaS platforms</li> <li>Active exploration or use of generative AI platforms (e.g., LLMs, technical document automation assistants) to optimize workflows</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LogicGate's Risk Cloud</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p>At LogicGate, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We are committed to delivering an exceptional experience for our employees and our customers by empowering and enabling our people to take ownership, make an impact, and deliver their best work.</p> <p><strong>Total Rewards&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are proud to offer a variety of competitive, inclusive, and comprehensive total rewards that are designed to support the unique needs of our employees both inside and outside of the workplace.</p> <p>In addition to offering competitive salary and variable compensation plans, equity options, and flexible health and wellness benefits, we are proud to offer generous PTO, Annual Company Holidays, Health Days, and Summer Fridays.</p> <p>Employees' growth and development are supported throughout their career journey through informal and formal programs and activities, including access to LinkedIn Learning, regular People Leader training, and our internal Mentorship Program.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Culture</strong></p> <p>At LogicGate, our culture and employee experience are grounded in our core values of Be as One, Do the Right Thing, Embrace Curiosity, Own It, Empower Customers, and Raise the Bar, which guide how we show up - for each other, our customers, and all we interact with.</p> <p>We believe that the strongest teams are made up of individuals who bring their different identities, experiences, and perspectives to the table. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work.</p> <p>We encourage everyone to join one of our Employee Resource Groups (AAPI @ LogicGate, Pride at LogicGate, and Women in LogicGate) to participate in and contribute to conversations that foster an inclusive culture.</p> <p>LogicGate also believes strongly in giving back to the communities in which we live and work. To enable our teams to give back, we offer paid volunteer hours and company-wide charitable activities supporting a variety of organizations and causes.</p> <p>We are proud to have been recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, the Chicago Tribune, and more. Visit <a href="https://www.logicgate.com/about-us/news-at-logicgate/#filter=">our website</a> to learn about our latest recognition.</p> <p>Learn more about our culture <a href="https://builtin.com/company/logicgate/office-culture">here</a>.&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
